 Early voting underway in Thomas County for runoff election 
 The runoff election will be held on Dec. 1 
 Early voting is officially underway in Thomas County. By WCTV Staff Published : Nov. 20, 2026 at 4:38 PM EST | Updated : 3 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google THOMAS COUNTY, Ga. (WCTV) - Early voting is officially underway in Thomas County.
 Neither of the candidates running for Thomas County Commission District 6 received the minimum of over 50% of the votes needed to win the election.
 Republican Adrian Burns Smith received 44% of the votes and Independent Otis Boyd secured 33%.
 The runoff election will be held on Dec. 1.
